title: AssayRouter: Historical Utility Priors for Frozen Molecular Predictor Routing
abstract: arXiv:2609.37285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Laboratories often face a new molecular assay with 16-64 labels and a bank of predictors whose training data and parameters are unavailable. The practical question is which frozen outputs to include in a small local model. AssayRouter treats completed assays as pseudo-targets and labels each candidate by its post-fit utility: the reduction in held-out discovery loss when the candidate is added to the local target predictor. A shared regressor learns to predict this utility from candidate behavior on the support set, without source identity; on a new assay, one frozen ranking selects four sources and separate labels fit a convex combiner. We train only on completed ChEMBL-MT assays and evaluate 24 external regression assays across six frozen interface families. translated_title: AssayRouter：用于冻结分子预测器路由的历史效用先验
translated_abstract: 实验室经常面临一个包含16-64个标签的新分子测定任务，同时手上有一批训练数据和参数均不可用的预测器。实际问题是应将哪些冻结的输出纳入一个小型的本地模型中。AssayRouter将已完成的测定视为伪目标，并通过后拟合效用为每个候选预测器打标签：即在将候选者加入本地目标预测器后，留出集发现损失的减少量。一个共享回归器学习仅从候选者在支持集上的行为（不依赖来源身份信息）来预测这一效用；在新的测定任务上，一次冻结的排序选出四个来源，并用单独的标签拟合一个凸组合器。我们仅在已完成的ChEMBL-MT测定上训练，并在六个冻结接口家族的24个外部回归测定上进行评估。相对于Support-CV@4，AssayRouter-C将严格的四次调用负对数似然（NLL）降低了0.0409。冻结的候选-标签置换实验证实了候选-效用的对应关系……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AssayRouter将已完成的测定视为伪目标，通过学习预测候选预测器加入本地模型后的效用提升来路由冻结的分子预测器，无需访问其训练数据或参数，即可在新测定任务上显著降低四次调用的负对数似然。
en_tdlr: AssayRouter routes frozen molecular predictors by treating completed assays as pseudo-targets and learning to predict each candidate's post-fit utility, enabling effective source selection without access to training data and reducing strict four-call NLL by 0.0409 on external regression assays.
